posts.name: fearothwow
posts.cooked:
I have been lurking these forums for a while, not posting much, but wanted to come out say thanks to everyone that works hard at this Great company. I found you guys about a year ago while researching more games to buy, thought Sentinels looked awesome so I picked it up, I was right. Withing two weeks I had all 3 expansions that were out at the time. I couldnt stay long at the Gathering of Heroes event earlier this year beacuse I had Friends waiting anxiously to play, but if you guys hold another one I will be there all day. But what I really came here to pose is about Sentinel Tactics. As with most people here I kickstarted it and was happy to here the news of it shipping out recnetly. I was happier to hear the Fedex truck pulling up to my complext this monring. Granted I live in St Louis about a hour from where you guys are, but damn, didnt know shipping was that fast. Thank you for everything you guys do, and sorry to make everyone else little jelous.

 

http://imgur.com/TntkJHO
